_comment: Red Team FAIL B remediation: the authoritative official KLPGA calendar -- the ONLY source HOME's 지난/이번/다음 대회 chronology (klpga.website_v2.tournament_chronology) may read tournament identity/dates/venue from. TOURNAMENT_SITE_REGISTRY.json remains route/presentation metadata only (url_base, hub_card display copy) and is joined onto an entry here by game_code -- it must never be the sole or primary source of a tournament's calendar identity, and internal pipeline stage-validation state (R1_LIVE, R2_LIVE, etc.) must never influence which entry here counts as last/current/next. Each entry's start_date/end_date/venue is the real, already-published official fact this repo has for that tournament, sourced from the artifact/commit named in source_identity -- never guessed or backfilled from a hub_card display string.
